authority: Experiment-specific EXIT-03 authorship. Values here are merged into the generated v2 programme surface and must cite corpus evidence; omission remains an explicit open cell.

overrides.detector_transfer_function: Calibrate the complex input-to-output scattering matrix against a bright reference arm and port standards, de-embed coupling and propagation loss, then restrict the polar-decomposed transfer to the independently reconstructed dark projector. Report projector chord distance, polar-unitary angle, log singular-value ratio and surviving unnormalised power; never normalize away the loss channel.
overrides.nuisance_and_covariance_model: Jointly propagate input-state preparation, coherent receiver gain/phase, wavelength drift, port cross-talk, common and differential loss, residual splitting, lithographic coupling errors and path-end error. Fit geometric, static-splitting and loss-only models to the same complex data, with calibration covariance shared across forward, reverse and path-order-swapped devices.
overrides.predicted_signal_scale: The reference design requires adiabatic error at most 0.02, relative splitting and differential-loss budgets at most 0.05, projector closure distance at most 0.01 and endpoint error about 0.01512 rad or less. The illustrative coupled-mode witness has kappa_0 L=240, dark-power retention 0.999689, log singular-value ratio 0.01174 and phase-blind quarter-turn fidelity 0.999983; these are design targets, not fabricated-device forecasts.
overrides.power_or_sensitivity_calculation: Before fabrication, inject the full calibrated covariance into a full-wave tolerance ensemble and require at least 90% power at one-sided alpha=0.05 to distinguish the reversed polar-unitary angle from both the static-splitting and differential-loss models while separately passing the 0.01 projector-closure and 0.05 nonunitarity budgets. For a contraction subtest, use the declared K>[z sigma/((1-m) theta_0)]^2 inequality rather than repetitions chosen after inspection.

build_go_no_go.go: A positive-coupling, phase-assisted or two-module full-wave layout realizes kappa_0 L at least 207.7968; at least 95% of the preregistered fabrication/noise ensemble passes closure, dark-space retention, reference visibility and the 0.05 splitting/loss budgets; and the power calculation clears 90% before mask release.
build_go_no_go.noGo: No signed-effective-coupling or positive-path layout retains a nonempty robustness wedge, reference visibility is insufficient to distinguish orientation, or the tolerance ensemble fails the preregistered pass fraction. Close the passive strict-quarter-turn build and move to the fast-holonomy or actively modulated branch.

physics_go_no_go.engineeringGo: A passing device establishes programmable projector return with coherent noncommuting transport and supplies a calibrated platform for selector experiments.
physics_go_no_go.newPhysicsGo: None from this emulator alone. Escalation requires the same unexplained residual on an independently fabricated carrier after the complete geometric, static, loss, calibration and detector models fail.
physics_go_no_go.noGo: A nuisance model spans the full record or the apparent sign disappears without the chosen reference; retain the result as a detector or control-engineering bound.

overrides.replication_rule: Repeat the blind protocol on a second fabrication run and on at least one independently routed forward/reverse device pair. Freeze the de-embedding and reference convention on the first run; the second run must pass the same absolute budgets without refitting their thresholds.
overrides.data_metadata_and_code_release_contract: Release masks or layout parameters, measured coupling and loss calibration, raw coherent port sweeps, reference-arm records, environmental metadata, covariance estimates, de-embedding code, full-wave model, tolerance draws, blinded labels and the frozen analysis configuration under one checksum manifest.

claim_status_propagation.positive: Advance OT-002 and the transport portion of OT-037 to experimentally demonstrated on this carrier; leave OT-003, fundamental symmetry and spontaneous-selection claims open.
claim_status_propagation.null: Close the tested passive layout and update OT-002/OT-037 to the measured nuisance or feasibility boundary; do not propagate the null to unrelated carriers.
claim_status_propagation.ambiguous: Retain the equivalence class in OT-001 and keep every mechanism claim unpromoted until the reference or covariance deficit is removed.

overrides.detector_transfer_function: Map raw transport voltages, currents and temperature gradients plus ellipsometric and magneto-optic readouts into one complex causal conductivity tensor with shared thickness/domain calibration. Freeze its imaginary-frequency posterior. Separately map calibrated resonator frequency shift or torsion angle into force gradient or torque versus distance and orientation, including separation and angular response; the force record may not update the tensor posterior.
overrides.nuisance_and_covariance_model: Carry same-batch and coupon-to-device variation, thickness, roughness spectrum, magnetic domains, temperature, field, optical extrapolation, Kramers-Kronig completion, absolute separation, patch-potential maps, electrostatic drift, ordinary magnetic force, oscillator calibration and temporal drift in one hierarchical covariance. Compare the frozen Lifshitz prediction with patch, roughness and magnetic alternatives and their mixtures.
overrides.predicted_signal_scale: No admissible force scale exists until the same-film off-diagonal tensor reaches the relevant band. For 0.1-1 micrometre separation the characteristic band is about 24-239 THz or 0.099-0.987 eV, whereas the retained Hall data end at 1.5 THz. The first quantitative prediction is therefore the posterior differential curve and its covariance after OT-006, not an extrapolated headline force.
overrides.power_or_sensitivity_calculation: Before force-device fabrication, propagate the frozen tensor and full nuisance covariance to the planned distance/angle grid. Require at least 90% power at alpha=0.05 for the parallel-minus-antiparallel or orientation-odd curve against the union of patch, roughness and ordinary magnetic models, with at least three independently calibrated separations contributing. If the covariance envelope spans the prediction, stop at spectroscopy.

build_go_no_go.go: One batch supplies overlapping complex sigma_xx and sigma_xy through at least 0.1-1 eV in both magnetic states; held-out transport/magneto-optic channels pass the frozen causal tensor; and the no-refit differential prediction exceeds the complete planned systematic covariance with the preregistered power.
build_go_no_go.noGo: The same-film tensor cannot be closed, allowed causal tails dominate, or the predicted differential remains inside the complete force-systematics envelope. Do not build or interpret the force stage.

physics_go_no_go.engineeringGo: Agreement validates a same-carrier response-to-boundary-force pipeline and improves materials and force metrology.
physics_go_no_go.newPhysicsGo: Only a replicated residual with the same distance/orientation signature, surviving independent tensor measurement and complete patch, roughness, magnetic, separation and drift models, may enter a new-physics lane.
physics_go_no_go.noGo: Agreement with a conventional nuisance or failure of the tensor closure updates the materials model; it is not evidence against admissibility or for new physics.

overrides.replication_rule: Repeat tensor closure on a second deposition batch before unblinding force data, then reproduce any force residual on an independently fabricated device or apparatus with separately measured patches and separation calibration. Shared growth or analysis code must be recorded as correlated, not counted as independent replication.
overrides.data_metadata_and_code_release_contract: Release raw transport, thermal-gradient, ellipsometry, magneto-optic and force/torque streams; specimen lineage; thickness, roughness, domain and patch maps; temperature/field/distance logs; calibration and covariance files; causal-tensor posterior samples; Lifshitz and nuisance code; blind labels; and frozen decision configuration with checksums.

claim_status_propagation.positive: Close OT-006 for the measured architecture and OT-007 for the tested geometry; promote only the no-refit same-carrier prediction, not a universal Jordan/Spin identification.
claim_status_propagation.null: If spectroscopy fails, narrow OT-006 and stop OT-007. If spectroscopy passes but force does not, retain the tensor and update the boundary/nuisance model.
claim_status_propagation.ambiguous: Keep OT-007 gated and publish the posterior overlap showing which tensor or nuisance coordinate prevents a decision.

overrides.detector_transfer_function: Infer the complex 2x2 response from independently calibrated voltage and heater drives to charge-current and heat-current records, including electrical bandwidth, thermometer thermal impedance, phase delay and contact de-embedding. Apply source-basis changes by congruence and track the energy-current convention explicitly; retain raw forces and currents so rank is not computed from normalized plots.
overrides.nuisance_and_covariance_model: Jointly model electrical contact impedance, heater leakage, thermometry gain and lag, substrate loss, radiative heat loss, geometry, magnetic pickup, common clock phase, energy-zero/current retyping and finite-frequency contact terms. Propagate correlated calibration errors into response eigenvalues, determinant and reciprocity residuals across the full frequency/temperature grid.
overrides.predicted_signal_scale: The existing five-coordinate benchmark places the second-to-first response ratio near 1.315e-3 to 1.637e-3 in its high-energy window. Certifying only a one-percent reduction permits about 0.279% combined one-sigma error at three sigma; resolving the predicted second direction requires below 438 ppm combined error, or about 310 ppm each for equal theory and detector budgets. These are design diagnostics until translated to the chosen microbridge.
overrides.power_or_sensitivity_calculation: Use the smallest preregistered eigenvalue ratio over the held-out frequency window as the effect size. Require three-sigma lower confidence above zero and 90% power at alpha=0.05 after the full errors-in-variables covariance, while reciprocity and passivity controls remain inside their calibrated bands. If the chosen device cannot reach 438 ppm for detection, predeclare the weaker one-percent rank-reduction test instead.

build_go_no_go.go: Independent charge and heat drives have a full-rank calibrated actuation matrix; electrical and thermal detector bandwidths overlap the declared window; thermal cross-talk and contact leakage remain below the selected 0.279% or 438 ppm objective; and simulation plus standards recover a known rank-two control with 90% power.
build_go_no_go.noGo: The drive matrix is rank deficient, thermal lag destroys phase recovery, energy-current convention cannot be controlled, or calibrated leakage exceeds the smaller singular direction. Stop rank interpretation and retain only instrument bounds.

physics_go_no_go.engineeringGo: A stable second direction validates multichannel transport and informs thermoelectric or hydrodynamic model design.
physics_go_no_go.newPhysicsGo: Escalation requires a replicated response component outside the complete Kubo, contact, screening-carrier, Ward/KMS and detector model—not rank two by itself.
physics_go_no_go.noGo: A rank-one result closes the declared operational window only; a nuisance-dominated result improves calibration without deciding the carrier theory.

overrides.replication_rule: Repeat the frozen protocol on a second microbridge from the same batch and one independent batch or platform. The second-batch analysis must reuse the source basis, energy-current convention, frequency window and thresholds fixed on the first without target-specific recalibration beyond declared standards.
overrides.data_metadata_and_code_release_contract: Release raw drive and current time streams, geometry and contact maps, thermometer/heater calibrations, environmental logs, response and covariance matrices, source-basis transformations, energy-current convention, KPM/typicality comparison inputs, inference code and frozen thresholds with checksums.

claim_status_propagation.positive: Advance the operational portion of OT-008 and constrain OT-016/OT-047 with the measured rank window; do not infer a universal H2(R) carrier or Spin symmetry.
claim_status_propagation.null: Close the rank-two claim only for the declared window and device; update contact, screening or low-frequency limits according to the winning null model.
claim_status_propagation.ambiguous: Leave OT-008 gated and record which calibration or convention direction overlaps the putative second mode.

overrides.detector_transfer_function: Generate gauge-complete complex helicity amplitudes on common phase-space points, fold them through the response/acceptance matrix and mass resolution, and expose the resulting quadratic coefficient matrix plus odd sideband moment. The 27 signed settings are simulation templates, not laboratory controls; observed data enter one frozen likelihood with charged, neutral and sideband categories.
overrides.nuisance_and_covariance_model: Profile renormalization and factorization scales, PDFs, matching and running, total width and branching assumptions, continuum phases, absorptive parts, top/bottom masses, direct gauge coefficients, CKM and form factors, background slope, odd acceptance leakage, mass resolution, category migration and finite Monte Carlo statistics. Preserve the exact (2,1,-1) electroweak redistribution null when the unrestricted EFT is fitted.
overrides.predicted_signal_scale: No physical event-yield forecast is admissible before the source-complete amplitudes are computed. The pre-data design scale is algebraic: 19 of 27 templates fit the ten quadratic coefficients, nine pair-plane contrasts audit closure and eight three-source corners remain held out; a surviving second singular shape and odd interference moment must exceed their propagated theory-plus-detector uncertainty.
overrides.power_or_sensitivity_calculation: After amplitude and detector folding but before observed-data unblinding, run Asimov and toy likelihoods over the declared mass/lifetime grid. Require at least 90% power at alpha=0.05 to reject the weak-quotient rank-one null at the preregistered non-collinearity threshold while all eight held-out corners and Ward residuals pass. Report exclusion-only regions where sign identification lacks power.

build_go_no_go.go: The full gauge-complete amplitude passes Ward checks, the 27-setting quadratic closure and held-out corners; a non-collinear signed shape survives detector folding; public likelihood inputs or a reproducible recast exist; and the power study clears the declared region before data unblinding.
build_go_no_go.noGo: The second shape disappears under source completion, violates Ward or held-out closure, is erased by detector folding, or no public likelihood supports the covariance. Retain the rank-one cross-scale constraint and stop the sixth-coordinate claim.

physics_go_no_go.engineeringGo: A positive result establishes an identifiable EFT coordinate combination and a reusable source-complete collider/meson likelihood.
physics_go_no_go.newPhysicsGo: Only observed data inconsistent with the complete seven-coordinate EFT, widths, running, hadronic and detector nuisance model and replicated in an independent channel may enter a new-physics escalation.
physics_go_no_go.noGo: Failure of the second shape closes this detector route without falsifying the EFT or the broader admissibility programme.

overrides.replication_rule: Validate the fitted kernel on all eight held-out simulation corners, then require an independent physical category or experiment—such as a separately reconstructed charged/neutral mode or meson channel—to reproduce the inferred invariant combination with the basis and thresholds frozen.
overrides.data_metadata_and_code_release_contract: Release model/UFO and parameter-card versions, amplitude and Ward-test code, phase-space seeds, all 27 template weights, response matrices, sideband definitions, covariance and nuisance priors, public-data identifiers, likelihood/recast code, held-out labels and frozen decision configuration under checksums.

claim_status_propagation.positive: Advance OT-048 for the declared process and constrain OT-047 with the measured invariant combination; preserve the unrestricted EFT null and do not infer ultraviolet origin labels.
claim_status_propagation.null: Close the proposed sixth-coordinate detector route if source completion restores the weak quotient; retain the resulting cross-scale likelihood and exact null structure.
claim_status_propagation.ambiguous: Keep OT-048 open, report whether theory, detector or public-likelihood covariance dominates, and forbid sign or rank promotion.

overrides.detector_transfer_function: Treat the pinned Lean kernel as the detector: source text is parsed and elaborated under a recorded toolchain, imports and options, then reduced to kernel-checked declarations. The reported record is the accepted type and proof term or the smallest reproducible elaboration/kernel failure, plus resource counters. Separate parser, elaborator, kernel and timeout outcomes rather than collapsing them into success/failure.
overrides.nuisance_and_covariance_model: Stratify compiler version, platform, import order, option state, namespace, reducibility attributes, heartbeat and memory limits, cache state and nondeterministic scheduling. Harmless presentation families share a cluster ID. Estimate failure rates and runtime tails by stratum; resource exhaustion is censored separately from logical unreachability.
overrides.predicted_signal_scale: The primary effect is categorical: a held-out declaration either has a kernel-checkable reachability witness or a stable minimal obstruction. Secondary scales are false prediction rate, witness size and runtime. The target is zero false reachable/unreachable classifications in the held-out set and byte-identical kernel outcomes across two clean pinned rebuilds.
overrides.power_or_sensitivity_calculation: Before evaluation, choose a stratified held-out set containing each constructor depth, overflow class and environment perturbation. Size each stratum so that observing zero failures gives a one-sided 95% upper bound below the declared tolerated error rate (for tolerance p, n must satisfy 0.05^(1/n) greater than or equal to 1-p); report exact binomial bounds and bootstrap runtime tails, not a post hoc accuracy score.

build_go_no_go.go: The toolchain, imports and resource envelope rebuild cleanly on two isolated hosts; every training witness kernel-checks; deliberately unreachable and overflow controls fail at their intended layer; and the held-out sample plus stopping rule are frozen.
build_go_no_go.noGo: Any accepted witness depends on an unrecorded option/import, clean hosts disagree, or timeout cannot be separated from logical obstruction. Repair provenance and detector typing before running the tournament.

physics_go_no_go.engineeringGo: A pass establishes a reproducible reachability sieve for the represented formal objects and improves proof-carrying corpus maintenance.
physics_go_no_go.newPhysicsGo: None. This experiment can validate a formal bridge used by physical claims but cannot itself establish a physical law.
physics_go_no_go.noGo: A failure localizes the dependence on environment, resources or formalization; it does not refute the informal mathematics without an independently checked translation.

overrides.replication_rule: Rebuild the frozen corpus on a second operating system or independently provisioned host from the lockfile, then have an independent implementation verify exported kernel objects or certificates. The held-out labels and resource ceiling remain unchanged.
overrides.data_metadata_and_code_release_contract: Release source declarations, equivalence-family and held-out labels, toolchain and dependency locks, complete environment/options manifest, build logs, kernel exports, minimal failures, resource traces, analysis code and checksums sufficient for an offline clean rebuild.

claim_status_propagation.positive: Promote only the tested reachability and reproducibility statements attached to OT-033/OT-035; preserve the distinction between kernel fact and physical interpretation.
claim_status_propagation.null: Mark the affected reachability claim environment- or resource-relative and reopen its downstream formal dependants.
claim_status_propagation.ambiguous: Record the exact disagreement stratum and forbid propagation until the kernel/resource boundary is resolved.

overrides.detector_transfer_function: Run each source-native equivalence family through the frozen parser/elaborator and a separately versioned normalizer, emitting raw syntax, elaborated term, kernel type, canonical address and every rewrite used. The detector record is the pairwise address mobility matrix annotated by kernel-checked equivalence, not the normalized string alone.
overrides.nuisance_and_covariance_model: Stratify alpha, beta, zeta, notation, metadata and definitional rewrites; compiler and normalizer versions; reducibility policy; generated-name order; and source family. Count false merges and splits with cluster-correlated intervals so many variants of one declaration do not masquerade as independent evidence.
overrides.predicted_signal_scale: The hard safety signal is any false merge of kernel-distinct, detector-relevant objects, with target count zero. Stability is the fraction of kernel-equivalent variants retaining one address; residual false splits must be bounded per rewrite family and carry an explicit multi-chart explanation.
overrides.power_or_sensitivity_calculation: Freeze a held-out matrix crossing rewrite families with declaration complexity. Use exact one-sided binomial bounds for the zero-false-merge target and cluster bootstrap intervals for split rates. Include adversarial near-equivalents at a prevalence high enough that the lower 95% bound on their detection exceeds the declared safety target.

build_go_no_go.go: All rewrites have kernel certificates, the address policy is deterministic on two clean builds, adversarial non-equivalents remain separated and the held-out family structure is frozen.
build_go_no_go.noGo: The policy erases a later detector distinction, depends on generated names or import order, or lacks certified equivalence labels. Retain raw identity and a multi-chart atlas.

physics_go_no_go.engineeringGo: A pass licenses the address policy for indexing and comparison within its declared equivalence classes.
physics_go_no_go.newPhysicsGo: None; canonicalization can expose stable structure but cannot turn address stability into physical ontology.
physics_go_no_go.noGo: A global-policy failure establishes the need for typed local charts rather than failure of the underlying objects.

overrides.replication_rule: Repeat on an independently generated rewrite corpus and a second pinned compiler/normalizer build. The second run must reuse the equivalence definition and merge threshold; version-specific splits are reported as separate charts.
overrides.data_metadata_and_code_release_contract: Release raw/elaborated terms, kernel equivalence certificates, rewrite provenance, canonicalization code and version, all addresses, pairwise mobility matrices, family labels, held-out split, build manifests and checksums.

claim_status_propagation.positive: Promote the canonical address only for the passed equivalence policy and point every dependent index to its versioned chart.
claim_status_propagation.null: Withdraw global canonicality, retain source-native identity and update downstream joins that used an invalid merge.
claim_status_propagation.ambiguous: Keep parallel addresses and expose the unresolved equivalence class rather than selecting one representation.

overrides.detector_transfer_function: For each carrier, freeze the map from intervention and latent model parameters through dynamics, port coupling, bandwidth, calibration and noise to the stored record. The adaptive policy may select only from preregistered detector channels using training records; separation is evaluated on untouched interventions with the complete transfer map retained.
overrides.nuisance_and_covariance_model: Use hierarchical nuisance blocks for carrier calibration, detector gain/phase, bandwidth, sampling, label permutation and shared simulator assumptions. Profile or marginalize them identically for both mechanisms. Exact algebraic collisions, local Fisher degeneracy and finite-noise overlap are reported as three different failure modes.
overrides.predicted_signal_scale: For each mechanism pair report global record-space distance after nuisance optimization, the smallest efficient-Fisher singular value locally, and detector cost at first separation. A valid quotient has zero global distance on all declared interventions; a practical separation must exceed the calibrated record covariance on held-out data.
overrides.power_or_sensitivity_calculation: Use pilot-free simulations or training strata to choose the enrichment policy, then Monte Carlo the held-out likelihood-ratio or equivalence test under the complete nuisance model. Require at least 90% power at alpha=0.05 for each claimed separation and simultaneous error control across pairs; certify algebraic equality symbolically where the expected distance is zero.

build_go_no_go.go: Every candidate channel has a calibrated transfer function and cost, known tangent-degenerate and exactly equivalent controls are recovered, the adaptive rule is frozen, and held-out interventions cover every claimed mechanism pair.
build_go_no_go.noGo: A channel is defined by the desired label, calibration differs between hypotheses, or the residual equality is already algebraic. Record the quotient instead of acquiring more of the same data.

physics_go_no_go.engineeringGo: A pass identifies the minimal detector set needed to distinguish the declared mechanisms on each carrier.
physics_go_no_go.newPhysicsGo: A new-physics branch requires a replicated record outside the union of all calibrated conventional mechanism fibres, not merely failure of one classifier.
physics_go_no_go.noGo: Exact equivalence closes identification for the declared detector family; noise-limited overlap sets a sensitivity bound and leaves richer detectors open.

overrides.replication_rule: Repeat the frozen enrichment policy on a separately generated benchmark and at least one independently calibrated physical or formal carrier. Separation must recur without adding channels selected from the replication labels.
overrides.data_metadata_and_code_release_contract: Release latent models, interventions, detector transfer maps, nuisance priors/covariances, raw records, adaptive choices and costs, held-out labels, equivalence certificates, likelihood code, random seeds and frozen decision rules.

claim_status_propagation.positive: Update the covered open topics with the minimal separating detector and its scope; never promote separation to identity of the latent mechanism.
claim_status_propagation.null: Record the exact quotient class or sensitivity ceiling and close only detector claims lying inside it.
claim_status_propagation.ambiguous: Preserve the competing mechanisms and name the additional intervention or detector direction needed to reopen the branch.

overrides.detector_transfer_function: Calibrate complex source waves and outgoing waves with vector-network standards, de-embed cables and fixture, then convert the measured scattering matrix to the declared impedance, admittance or response convention with its reference impedance recorded. For the common-sample arm, retain raw particle/energy forces and currents and propagate electrical and thermal transfer functions before forming the 2 by 2 matrix.
overrides.nuisance_and_covariance_model: Jointly include VNA gain/phase, reference-impedance and fixture error, cable drift, port cross-talk, nonreciprocity, loss and basis transformation; add contacts, thermal leakage, clock phase and energy-current convention for the material arm. Carry correlated calibration covariance into eigenvalues and determinant with passivity-constrained and unconstrained fits shown.
overrides.predicted_signal_scale: The response must have a positive lower eigenvalue separated from zero after covariance and remain nonzero under allowed source congruences. No universal numerical ratio is assumed: the design effect is the minimum second-to-first eigenvalue ratio over the preregistered frequency window, measured first on standards and then forecast for the common-sample arm.
overrides.power_or_sensitivity_calculation: From calibration-only data, select a window and compute the smallest detectable eigenvalue using covariance-aware simulations of rank-one and passive rank-two matrices. Require at least 90% power at alpha=0.05 to reject the rank-one boundary while the false passivity-violation rate remains below 5%, including the look-elsewhere correction for the frequency window.

build_go_no_go.go: Open, short, load/thru and synthetic rank-one controls recover their declared cones; the full source actuation matrix is calibrated; the rank-two forecast clears 90% power; and basis/energy-gauge transformations are frozen before the sample run.
build_go_no_go.noGo: Cross-talk, reference-plane uncertainty or thermal leakage is comparable to the smaller eigenvalue, or positivity depends on an unregistered convention. Retain only an instrument bound.

physics_go_no_go.engineeringGo: A microwave pass validates cone tomography and calibrates the method; a common-sample pass establishes operational rank two in the declared window.
physics_go_no_go.newPhysicsGo: None from rank two alone. Escalation needs a replicated response outside complete passive/Kubo/contact and convention models.
physics_go_no_go.noGo: Rank one closes only the tested carrier/window; a passivity failure first challenges calibration or model adequacy, not positivity as an ontology.

overrides.replication_rule: Repeat with a second calibration kit/reference plane and a separately fabricated network; for material claims repeat on a second device and batch using the same window and rank threshold.
overrides.data_metadata_and_code_release_contract: Release raw complex waves or forces/currents, calibration standards, fixture and geometry files, environmental logs, de-embedding transformations, response matrices and covariance, basis/convention changes, simulations, frozen window and analysis code with checksums.

claim_status_propagation.positive: Advance OT-008/OT-047 only for the measured carrier and window, distinguishing positive response, rank and any later Jordan interpretation.
claim_status_propagation.null: Record the rank-one or convention boundary and reopen only downstream claims that required the missing direction.
claim_status_propagation.ambiguous: Leave rank unpromoted and publish the covariance eigen-direction or passivity residual causing the ambiguity.

overrides.detector_transfer_function: Measure the full complex port transfer against an independently injected coherent phase reference, de-embed reciprocal propagation and insertion loss, and form a preregistered orientation-odd contrast from physically reversed loop order, boundary axis or chirality. Keep even overlap, attenuation and reference visibility as separate records.
overrides.nuisance_and_covariance_model: Jointly fit reference phase/gain drift, path-length and temperature drift, polarization leakage, port permutation, reciprocal and nonreciprocal phase, differential loss, fabrication asymmetry and detector nonlinearity. Share calibration covariance across forward, reversed, reference-off and loss-matched records; allow gauge rephasings explicitly.
overrides.predicted_signal_scale: The effect is the reversal-odd phase or dimensionless two-frequency contrast after minimization over allowed basis phases. Its forecast is carrier-specific and must exceed both the odd leakage seen in reciprocal controls and the propagated phase-reference covariance; even intensity change is not counted as orientation evidence.
overrides.power_or_sensitivity_calculation: Use calibration and reference-off data to freeze an odd-contrast uncertainty and simulate forward/reverse pairs. Require at least 90% power at alpha=0.05 after multiple-frequency correction to detect the forecast sign flip, while the same statistic remains null on reciprocal and loss-matched controls. Predeclare a circular-statistics test if phase wrapping is possible.

build_go_no_go.go: The phase reference is observable without selected-state data, physical reversal can be performed without changing the calibrated transfer chain, reciprocal controls bound odd leakage below the forecast and the power calculation clears the declared frequencies.
build_go_no_go.noGo: The reference axis is inferred retrospectively, reversal also changes an uncontrolled port or loss, or gauge minimization removes the contrast. Do not claim an orientation lift.

physics_go_no_go.engineeringGo: A pass establishes a carrier-native orientation witness and a calibrated reversal protocol.
physics_go_no_go.newPhysicsGo: Only a replicated residual outside reciprocity-breaking, chirality, loss, drift and detector models may be escalated; the expected geometric sign flip is not new physics.
physics_go_no_go.noGo: A removable phase or loss mimic closes the tested witness while leaving other independently referenced orientation detectors open.

overrides.replication_rule: Repeat on a separately routed or fabricated loop and with an independent reference-axis realization. Freeze the gauge convention, frequency pair and contrast before the replication; require both reversal operations to reproduce the sign structure.
overrides.data_metadata_and_code_release_contract: Release raw complex port data, phase-reference records, reversal and port maps, environmental logs, reciprocal/reference-off/loss controls, calibration covariance, de-embedding and gauge transformations, frozen contrasts and analysis code with checksums.

claim_status_propagation.positive: Advance OT-003/OT-039 only to experimentally referenced orientation on this carrier; do not infer selection, fundamental chirality or a universal complex structure.
claim_status_propagation.null: Close the chosen orientation observable at its measured sensitivity and identify whether gauge, loss or reference failure supplied the null.
claim_status_propagation.ambiguous: Retain the even response and leave the orientation claim open until an independent reference separates phase from loss.

overrides.detector_transfer_function: Tomographically reconstruct the state after every cycle from calibrated complex port records, then infer the return map in a fixed carrier-native coordinate chart. Estimate its fixed point and Jacobian from all initial states together. The independently actuated Y segment has its own on/off transfer calibration and loss-matched dummy; it may not be inferred from the selected endpoint.
overrides.nuisance_and_covariance_model: Jointly model state-preparation error, tomography gain/phase, cycle-dependent loss, drift, saturation, finite bandwidth, uncontrolled anisotropy, leakage, Y cross-talk and coordinate-chart uncertainty. Fit selector, uniform contraction, pure-loss and pre-existing-axis alternatives to the same trajectories with shared calibration covariance.
overrides.predicted_signal_scale: The primary signals are the Y-on minus Y-off fixed-point displacement and the largest transverse Jacobian eigenvalue below one. Forecast both from the calibrated carrier model; require displacement larger than the combined fixed-point covariance and contraction distinguishable from uniform attenuation across several initial states.
overrides.power_or_sensitivity_calculation: Simulate the complete trajectory and tomography model before running. Choose initial states and cycle count for at least 90% power at alpha=0.05 to reject both unchanged-fixed-point and loss-only nulls, with familywise control across tangent directions. State a maximum cycle count before drift dominates and a minimum detectable basin displacement.

build_go_no_go.go: Y is independently measurable and switchable, the loss-matched dummy reproduces attenuation without the predicted axis shift, observability of the return-map Jacobian is full rank and the power study clears the chosen initial-state ensemble.
build_go_no_go.noGo: Y exists only as a retrospective fit, tomography cannot separate axis motion from loss, or the carrier implements neutral holonomy without a distinct selector. Retain the platform as a transport experiment only.

physics_go_no_go.engineeringGo: A pass demonstrates controlled basin selection and supplies a programmable attractor or memory element.
physics_go_no_go.newPhysicsGo: None on an engineered emulator. A fundamental claim would require the same unexplained selector residue in a non-programmed system after its environment and measurement channels are closed.
physics_go_no_go.noGo: Y-independent contraction or a loss explanation rejects selection by the proposed channel without rejecting holonomy.

overrides.replication_rule: Repeat with a second Y realization or carrier and a fresh set of initial states selected before seeing replication data. The Y calibration, coordinate chart and Jacobian threshold are frozen from the first device.

overrides.predicted_signal_scale: Report the trace-distance or contraction-rate difference between conditioned branches and the unconditional channel, plus the weight of missed outcomes. overrides.nuisance_and_covariance_model: Propagate localization error, motion blur, sampling, hydrodynamic drag and memory, trap stiffness, stage drift, laser heating, feedback latency, potential reconstruction, calculus convention and controller energy. overrides.predicted_signal_scale: Protocols are matched on endpoint distribution and contraction within tolerance; the effects are differences in mean and distribution of work, heat, activity and erased bits. overrides.power_or_sensitivity_calculation: Choose trajectory count by sequentially forbidden, pre-run Monte Carlo under the full calibrated stochastic model. Require at least 90% power at alpha=0.05 for the smallest preregistered pairwise cost difference after multiplicity correction while equivalence tests confirm matched endpoint contraction. Include rare-tail effective sample size.

physics_go_no_go.engineeringGo: A pass maps a usable precision-speed-cost surface for stochastic control.
physics_go_no_go.newPhysicsGo: Only a reproducible violation of complete stochastic energetics after hidden controller and bath channels are closed could escalate; protocol-dependent cost is expected physics.
physics_go_no_go.noGo: Cost equality narrows the calibrated protocol family but does not make contraction a universal cost proxy.

overrides.data_metadata_and_code_release_contract: Release raw detector and controller streams, frame timestamps, calibration movies, potential protocols, bath/environment logs, trajectory inclusion rules, work/heat convention, reset ledger, covariance/bootstrap blocks, simulation and inference code, random seeds and thresholds.

overrides.detector_transfer_function: Calibrate drive and output amplitude/phase with bandwidth, impulse-response and dead-time corrections, then retain every time-stamped switch rather than thresholded averages alone. overrides.nuisance_and_covariance_model: Model detector lag/dead time, drive calibration, injected and intrinsic noise, temperature, laser/current drift, sweep-rate error, threshold ambiguity, missed short dwells and nonstationarity. Compare a shared metastable landscape against deterministic bifurcation, coloured-noise and filtered-single-state models with day-level random effects.
overrides.predicted_signal_scale: Forecast switching-rate curves, residence-time tail parameters, hysteresis width versus sweep rate and reversal asymmetry from one calibrated model. The decisive effect is simultaneous prediction of these records; no single long dwell or loop area is sufficient.
overrides.power_or_sensitivity_calculation: Use pilot calibration, not selected rare events, to set dwell and sweep counts. Require at least 90% power at alpha=0.05 to distinguish the landscape from detector-lag and deterministic alternatives on held-out protocols; predeclare tail diagnostics and stop when drift contribution exceeds counting uncertainty.

build_go_no_go.go: Single-event efficiency and dead time are calibrated below the shortest retained dwell, both mono- and bistable controls are accessible, environmental drift is logged, and simulations show the planned campaign distinguishes rate and lag models.
build_go_no_go.noGo: State classification is threshold-created, detector memory matches the hysteresis scale or drift dominates the attainable rare-event count. Restrict the result to an instrument bound.

physics_go_no_go.engineeringGo: A pass yields a predictive switching landscape for memory and oscillator design.
physics_go_no_go.newPhysicsGo: Only a replicated tail or reversal law outside complete nonlinear, noise and detector models could escalate; metastability and hysteresis themselves are conventional.
physics_go_no_go.noGo: A lag or bandwidth account closes the metastable interpretation of this record without ruling out metastability in another regime.

overrides.replication_rule: Repeat randomized sweeps on a later day after independent impulse-response calibration and on a second device where feasible. Freeze the state classifier, drift test and tail family; require prediction across at least one held-out sweep rate and perturbation.
overrides.data_metadata_and_code_release_contract: Release continuous raw drive/output traces, all event times, classification rule, impulse/dead-time calibration, noise injections, environmental logs, randomized order, excluded intervals, model likelihoods, simulation/power code and frozen stopping rule.

overrides.detector_transfer_function: Calibrate complex end-port scattering and local probe response over one common frequency grid, de-embed cables/couplers and transform ringdown through the measured impulse response. overrides.nuisance_and_covariance_model: Jointly include frequency and phase calibration, external coupling, site disorder, nonuniform loss, finite probe loading, background paths, model order, finite band, sampling density, phase unwrap and Riemann-sheet choice. overrides.predicted_signal_scale: The carrier model forecasts pole position and residue versus defect coupling, bound-state localization, edge-collision scaling, ringdown lifetime, phase winding and Wigner delay. A branch-consistent result requires all of these to agree within propagated covariance, not merely a fitted resonance peak.
overrides.power_or_sensitivity_calculation: Use synthetic recovery with the measured noise and bandwidth to set frequency density, coupling steps and ringdown length. Require at least 90% recovery of the correct pole count and collision law at alpha=0.05 across the forecast range, with a predeclared equivalence region where loss makes sheet continuation non-identifiable.

build_go_no_go.go: The uniform and disconnected controls pass, local and end-port bands cover every forecast pole plus margins, model-order recovery succeeds on blinded synthetics and loss leaves a nonempty identifiable collision interval.
build_go_no_go.noGo: The finite band hides compensating spectral weight, probe loading shifts poles at the effect scale or sheet/model-order ambiguity spans the collision. Freeze claims at the finite carrier.

physics_go_no_go.engineeringGo: A pass establishes a unified finite-carrier pole, winding and delay ledger useful for resonator and defect design.

physics_go_no_go.noGo: Sampling- or branch-dependent crossings close the claimed continuation while retaining measured finite-band spectra.

claim_status_propagation.null: Record the finite-band, loss or branch boundary and retract any unsupported pole-to-cut continuation.

overrides.detector_transfer_function: Calibrate source and site-resolved complex field probes against uniform-lattice standards, deconvolve transducer bandwidth, and reconstruct local density, localization length and the multiport scattering matrix in one fixed phase convention. overrides.nuisance_and_covariance_model: Propagate site/coupling disorder, boundary termination, source/probe loading, gain/phase drift, loss, finite lattice size, fabrication geometry and blind relabelling. overrides.predicted_signal_scale: Matched defects have equal protected mode count by construction. overrides.power_or_sensitivity_calculation: Use disorder ensembles and measured detector noise before fabrication to choose lattice size, probe density and repeats. Require at least 90% power at alpha=0.05 to classify held-out same-index defects by a preregistered non-index statistic, with false separation below 5% under blind geometric relabelling and multiplicity control.

build_go_no_go.noGo: The gap closes first, boundary choices span the contrast or detector phase is insufficient. Retain only the topological count.

physics_go_no_go.engineeringGo: A pass supplies defect information beyond mode count for wave routing and quotient-scar design.
physics_go_no_go.newPhysicsGo: None on an engineered lattice; topology does not itself imply fundamental spacetime structure.

Correct for fitting several invariant candidates and state the smallest detectable exponent drift.

build_go_no_go.noGo: Detector convolution or boundary time spans the apparent cone, fewer than three usable scales remain or fitted constants drift through the design range.

physics_go_no_go.engineeringGo: A pass gives transferable finite-scale propagation and memory bounds for the carrier family.

overrides.detector_transfer_function: Construct exact operator matrices only from declared source multiplication, incidence or neighbour rules; apply them to the graded finite data and emit exact products, commutators, traces, integral forms and residual certificates. overrides.predicted_signal_scale: A signal is an exact nontrivial operator identity—Hecke-type multiplication, modular trace constraint or product preservation—with zero rational residual and at least one held-out consequence. Approximate decimal agreement, dimensions and prime occupancy have no positive weight.
overrides.power_or_sensitivity_calculation: Enumerate the preregistered natural operator families and identity set exactly. Control search multiplicity by reserving identities or graded traces not used to choose the family; require exact satisfaction and failure under label/multiplication-destroying controls. Report the finite family count rather than a statistical p-value.

build_go_no_go.noGo: Only labels/dimensions exist, multiplication is invented to fit the target or operator choices are effectively unbounded. Close as numerology.

physics_go_no_go.engineeringGo: A pass establishes a genuine finite operator algebra in the corpus and a reusable exact certificate.

overrides.nuisance_and_covariance_model: Jointly propagate both devices' preparation/readout covariance, fabrication tolerances, basis and phase gauges, timing/frequency conversion, port relabelling, loss and map-parameter uncertainty. overrides.predicted_signal_scale: The effects are composition residual on held-out words and error of a native target observable predicted from source data without refitting. Both must fall inside propagated two-carrier covariance while fitted-similarity controls expose the extra freedom they use.
overrides.power_or_sensitivity_calculation: Select generators for calibration and reserve noncommuting composites for test. Simulate joint covariance and require at least 90% power at alpha=0.05 to reject one-generator/unlabelled-similarity nulls plus 90% predictive coverage for the held-out native observable.

build_go_no_go.go: The source-side map preserves products symbolically, both carrier process matrices and units are identifiable, held-out composites are feasible and the covariance study resolves fixed-map from fitted similarity.
build_go_no_go.noGo: Product preservation fails, the map erases labels/units/orientation or target agreement requires path-specific refitting. Do not build or promote the second-carrier bridge.

claim_status_propagation.null: Close the common-carrier identification at the failed product, label, unit or observable layer.

overrides.detector_transfer_function: For each model family, compute the declared gap/positivity observable with certified finite-size, regulator, time and boundary errors and export extremizing states or sequences. overrides.nuisance_and_covariance_model: Treat volume, regulator, time, observable class, boundary condition, solver truncation and numerical precision as independent limit directions. Bound deterministic errors with interval/certified numerics and compare all order-of-limits permutations; boundary-localized modes are tracked separately from bulk extrema.
overrides.predicted_signal_scale: A successful bound has a strictly positive lower constant common to the whole declared parameter tube. A decisive null is a certified admissible countersequence whose bound tends to zero or changes sign; larger isolated finite values do not repair it.
overrides.power_or_sensitivity_calculation: Use deterministic error budgets, convergence envelopes and adversarial optimization rather than sampling power. Predeclare the parameter tube and tolerance: the certified lower interval must remain above zero everywhere, or an upper-bounded countersequence must enter the zero neighbourhood with monotone/error-controlled convergence.

build_go_no_go.go: Known gapped/gapless and positivity-violation controls are recovered, every limit coordinate has at least three controlled scales, certified error is below the target margin and extremizers can be exported.
build_go_no_go.noGo: Uncontrolled order-of-limits, boundary states or numerical error spans zero. Scope the result to finite parameters.

physics_go_no_go.engineeringGo: A pass gives a reliable uniform bound for the declared model class.
physics_go_no_go.newPhysicsGo: No new physics follows from the theorem alone; a physical claim needs a validated carrier and parameter dictionary.
physics_go_no_go.noGo: A certified countersequence is a scoped no-go and must propagate to every claim requiring uniformity.

overrides.data_metadata_and_code_release_contract: Release model definitions, parameter tube, limit order, solver and precision settings, raw extrema, boundary classification, interval/error certificates, convergence fits, proof objects, countersequences and executable environments.

claim_status_propagation.null: Propagate the certified countersequence to all dependent universal claims while retaining finite observations.
claim_status_propagation.ambiguous: Mark the unresolved limit/error coordinate and prohibit uniform language.

overrides.detector_transfer_function: Calibrate the source mass position/rotation phase and spin sensor response to a pseudomagnetic field, including shielding, transfer bandwidth and phase delay; demodulate blind at source harmonics and distance/orientation reversals. Map the action's mass and species couplings into this record and into public flavour/collider/cosmology likelihood terms with one versioned parameter dictionary.
overrides.nuisance_and_covariance_model: Include magnetic contamination and shielding, vibration, rotation pickup, field gradients, comagnetometer species response, spin relaxation, geometry and distance, Earth/ambient fields and phase leakage; add matching, hadronic/nuclear, astrophysical and cosmological covariance plus public-likelihood correlations. Compare generic pseudoscalar coefficients with the protected-map restriction.

No apparatus-specific amplitude is admissible before the operator/species map is fixed.
overrides.power_or_sensitivity_calculation: Before construction, propagate existing bounds and the full transfer/noise model to an exclusion/discovery curve versus mass and coupling. Require at least 90% power at alpha=0.05 for a predeclared range/reversal signature in an unexcluded region and a held-out channel prediction; include look-elsewhere and global-likelihood coverage by toys.

build_go_no_go.go: The action fixes the measured operator and species ratios, an open parameter region remains, dummy-source and environmental channels bound synchronous backgrounds below forecast and the range/reversal power target passes.
build_go_no_go.noGo: Only generic free coefficients are available, existing likelihoods close the reach or source-correlated magnetic/mechanical backgrounds span it. Do not assign a torsion interpretation.

physics_go_no_go.newPhysicsGo: A signal must reproduce blind phase, distance/range and two orientation or species ratios, survive generic background/pseudoscalar comparison, and occupy one common no-refit global point.
physics_go_no_go.noGo: An incompatible cross-channel parameter or conventional background closes the protected interpretation; retain generic constraints.

claim_status_propagation.ambiguous: Retain generic pseudoscalar/background alternatives and identify the missing reversal, species or likelihood closure.

overrides.detector_transfer_function: Parse one explicit action, representation and vacuum into canonical symbolic tensors; compute gauge/global anomalies, kinetic signatures, gauge-fixed Hessian, masses, couplings, thresholds and running, then translate a frozen low-energy subset through a declared detector/likelihood model. Each stage exports machine-checkable residuals and the parameter freedoms it consumed.
overrides.nuisance_and_covariance_model: Track basis/embedding equivalence, gauge fixing, normalization, vacuum branch, renormalization scheme/scale, threshold matching, numerical diagonalization and experimental nuisance. Count effective parameters after symmetries and constraints; compare the same observables with an independent low-energy EFT using complexity-penalized predictive performance.
overrides.predicted_signal_scale: Hard gates are exact anomaly cancellation, positive physical kinetic terms and a Hessian with no forbidden unstable directions plus the required gauge/matter spectrum. Only after those pass is the signal a quantitative held-out low-energy observable with uncertainty narrower than and predictive score better than the independent EFT baseline.
overrides.power_or_sensitivity_calculation: Use exact algebra for anomaly and representation gates and certified eigenvalue intervals near zero. Before confronting held-out data, run prior/posterior predictive simulations or profile-likelihood toys to require at least 90% power for the no-refit prediction against the matched EFT baseline while penalizing every free embedding/threshold parameter.

build_go_no_go.go: The full action/dictionary/vacuum is explicit; anomaly, ghost and Hessian gates pass exactly or with certified margin; matching is determined; parameter count is finite and a held-out observable with adequate discriminating power exists.
build_go_no_go.noGo: Any anomaly, ghost, unstable coloured/charged direction, arbitrary embedding or underdetermined matching terminates the candidate immediately.

physics_go_no_go.engineeringGo: A pass through formal gates supplies a consistent model and reusable symbolic pipeline, not yet evidence nature uses it.
physics_go_no_go.newPhysicsGo: Only a no-refit held-out observable that beats the equally tested EFT and replicates in an independent channel supports the exceptional model.
physics_go_no_go.noGo: Failure localizes the model gate; dimension matches and aesthetic unification retain no evidential force.

overrides.replication_rule: Require independent symbolic anomaly/Hessian implementation and reproduce the held-out prediction in a second observable or dataset with embeddings and thresholds frozen. Near-zero stability directions need certified high-precision replication.
overrides.data_metadata_and_code_release_contract: Release action and conventions, representation/embedding tables, vacuum solution, anomaly certificates, gauge fixing, Hessian and eigenvalue certificates, spectrum, RG/threshold code, full parameter ledger, EFT baseline, likelihood inputs, held-out labels and executable locks.

claim_status_propagation.positive: Promote each passed gate separately for OT-026/OT-032/OT-038/OT-042/OT-045/OT-049/OT-050; reserve physical support for replicated predictions.
claim_status_propagation.null: Terminate the candidate at the first failed hard gate and propagate that dependency without generalizing to all exceptional models.
claim_status_propagation.ambiguous: Keep the candidate unpromoted and name the unresolved embedding, zero mode, threshold or likelihood coordinate.

overrides.detector_transfer_function: Convert time-tagged state-dependent fluorescence into prepared-state survival using independently measured bright/dark confusion, dead time and shelving errors. Convert calibrated 854 nm power, frequency and polarization at the ion into the addressed spherical-tensor components, and fit the same level Hamiltonian to spectral and time-domain records without equating total linewidth with population decay.
overrides.nuisance_and_covariance_model: Jointly model state-preparation and readout error, quench-beam intensity/frequency drift, polarization impurity, magnetic-field magnitude and direction, off-resonant coupling, saturation and power broadening, collision quenching, cooling/trap-light leakage, motional sidebands, pure dephasing, background counts and dead time. Share calibration covariance across detuning, intensity, orientation and helicity runs.
overrides.predicted_signal_scale: In the weak unsaturated regime the added population-decay rate is linear in calibrated 854 nm intensity at fixed detuning, with detuning and polarization ratios fixed by the same level Hamiltonian, Clebsch–Gordan coefficients and reduced electric-dipole matrix element. The absolute forecast and detectable minimum must be computed from platform calibration before data unblinding.
overrides.power_or_sensitivity_calculation: Use pilot bright/dark confusion, intrinsic survival variance and laser/polarization calibration to simulate the joint survival and spectral likelihood. Freeze an intensity-detuning-polarization grid giving at least 90% power at alpha=0.05 to reject collision/leakage-only and polarization-independent alternatives while resolving the weakest preregistered nonzero tensor component; report an upper limit if that grid is infeasible.

build_go_no_go.go: The apparatus reproduces the accepted intrinsic D5/2 lifetime and dark-state quantum jump; 854 nm power, frequency and polarization at the ion are calibrated; off-resonant, wrong-polarization, pressure and blocked-beam controls bound nuisance openings below the forecast; and the frozen grid reaches 90% discrimination power.
build_go_no_go.noGo: Intrinsic lifetime or fluorescence classification fails, calibration uncertainty spans the operator ratios, time- and frequency-domain records cannot be joined after dephasing, or a nuisance opening exceeds the target. Repair the platform before interpreting selection or lifetime.

physics_go_no_go.engineeringGo: A pass establishes a calibrated way to open, close and measure a weak channel and validates the complete operator-to-record ledger on one carrier.
physics_go_no_go.newPhysicsGo: Escalate only a replicated residual with a stable but wrong angular, helicity, intensity or detuning signature after known multipoles, relativistic/hyperfine mixing, environmental channels, saturation, dephasing and detector effects fail quantitatively.
physics_go_no_go.noGo: Agreement with the standard operator model is useful calibration, not new physics; a null bounds the opening coefficient or sensitivity; a nuisance explanation closes only the tested interpretation.

overrides.replication_rule: Repeat the frozen operator and nuisance model on a second ion/trap calibration, then reproduce any anomalous tensor signature on an independently calibrated apparatus. The helium arm is a transfer test of the ledger, not a substitute for ion replication.
overrides.data_metadata_and_code_release_contract: Release time-tagged fluorescence, preparation/readout calibration, quench power/frequency/polarimetry at the ion, magnetic-field and pressure logs, observation windows, level-Hamiltonian and reduced-matrix-element conventions, nuisance priors/covariance, blinded settings, likelihood and power code, and a checksum manifest.

claim_status_propagation.positive: Advance OT-036 only to demonstrated operator opening and detector closure on this atomic carrier; do not infer exceptional, Jordan or Spin(2,3) origin.
claim_status_propagation.null: Publish the matrix-element or rate upper bound and the sensitivity/nuisance boundary; leave other operators and carriers open.
claim_status_propagation.ambiguous: Record whether strength, environment, dephasing, polarization or detector folding remains unidentified and prohibit a transition-mechanism claim.
